blocks.text: Carbohydrates naturally occurring (qudrati tor par milne wale) organic compounds hain. In mein sugars (shakar), starch (nishasta), cellulose, aur bacteria ki cell walls aur insects (keeron) ke bahar wale sakht khol (exoskeleton) ke maadde shamil hain. Yeh hamari diet (khurak) mein energy ka bara source (zariya) hain. Kitab kehti hai ke tamam carbohydrates 'carbon ke hydrates' hain. Chemistry ki zabaan mein yeh polyhydroxy aldehydes ya ketones hain (yani aise aldehydes ya ketones jin mein bohat se –OH groups hon), ya un se bane compounds.

1. Monosaccharides sab se saada carbohydrates hain jinhein aam taur par sugars kehte hain, maslan glucose aur fructose. Inhein hydrolysis (paani ke saath reaction se torna) kar ke mazeed saada compounds mein nahi toda ja sakta. In ka general formula Cₙ(H₂O)y hai, jahan n teen se saat tak hota hai. Teen carbon wala monosaccharide triose, chaar wala tetrose, paanch wala pentose aur chhe wala hexose kehlata hai. Functional group ke lihaz se bhi inhein do qismon mein baanta jata hai: ketose (jis mein ketone group ho) aur aldose (jis mein aldehyde group ho). Glucose aldose hai jab ke fructose ketose hai.

blocks.alt: Glucose ki open chain (carbon 1 se 6, C1 par aldehyde group) jis mein C5 ke OH ki oxygen ke lone pairs se C1 tak muda hua teer hai, phir teer, aur ring ki shakal: C1 se C5 aur oxygen se bani chhe atoms wali ring, C5 par CH2OH (C6) oopar, aur har ring carbon par H aur OH.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.1: Glucose ki linear (seedhi) aur cyclic (ring wali) structures (kitab ki Figure 27.1 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).
blocks.long_description: Halqe mein C5 ke OH group ki oxygen C1 se jur jati hai; ab C1 par aik OH group (neeche) aur aik H atom hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Figure 27.1 ke labels mein kitab ne 'glucose open-chain from' aur 'glucose: ring from' chhapa hai. Sahi lafz 'form' (shakal) hai: glucose open-chain form aur glucose ring form.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab monosaccharides ki misal mein 'glucose and sucrose' likhti hai. Sucrose monosaccharide nahi, disaccharide hai (kitab khud aage Disaccharides mein yahi batati hai). Sahi misalein: glucose aur fructose.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Muda hua laal teer dikhata hai ke C5 ke OH ki oxygen apne lone pair se C1 ke C=O carbon par hamla karti hai. Is se oxygen C1 aur C5 ke darmiyan pul ban jati hai aur chhe kone wala ring (pyranose) banta hai; C=O ki oxygen ab C1 par OH ban jati hai (laal). Neela O wahi oxygen hai jo pehle C5 ke OH mein thi.

Monosaccharides do shaklon mein milte hain: open chain (khuli chain) ya ring. Paanch carbon wali sugars (pentoses) aur chhe carbon wali sugars (hexoses) ring ki shakal mein zyada stable (mazboot, aasani se na badalne wali) hoti hain, is liye zyada tar ring ki shakal mein milti hain. Solid (thos) halat mein yeh ring ki shakal mein hoti hain. Maslan fructose paanch kone wala ring banata hai jise furanose kehte hain, aur glucose chhe kone wala ring banata hai jise pyranose kehte hain. Linear (seedhi) chain aur ring wali shakalein aik doosre mein badal sakti hain. Glucose ki linear chain se ring banna (cyclisation) Figure 27.1 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke solution (ghol) mein molecules linear (seedhi chain) ki shakal mein hote hain. Asal mein solution mein bhi zyada tar molecules ring ki shakal mein hote hain, aur open chain wali shakal bohat thori (glucose ke liye 1% se bhi kam) hoti hai; dono shakalein equilibrium (barabar ki halat) mein rehti hain.

Sugar ke molecules mein bohat se hydroxyl groups (–OH) hote hain, is liye un ke molecules ke darmiyan bohat zyada hydrogen bonding hoti hai. Isi wajah se pure (khalis) monosaccharides solid hote hain. Solution mein yeh paani ke molecules se bhi bohat hydrogen bonds banate hain, is liye paani mein bohat zyada soluble (ghulne wale) hain. Monosaccharides jaandaron ke liye instant (fauran milne wali) energy ka behtareen source hain. Glucose ko blood sugar kehte hain kyun ke yeh insani khoon mein hota hai, jab ke fructose phalon aur shehed (honey) mein zyada hota hai.

blocks.alt: Sunehre shehed se bhara aik gol shishe ka jar, chaukor taat (jute ke kapre) ki chatai par rakha hai. Oopar daen taraf se lakri ka honey dipper (shehed nikalne ki chamach) jar ke oopar hai aur us se gaarhe shehed ki patli dhaar jar mein gir rahi hai.
blocks.caption: Shehed mein fructose aur glucose bohat zyada concentration (miqdar) mein hote hain. Shehed ka gaarha pan aur viscosity (gaarha hone ki wajah se aahista behna) inhi ki mazboot hydrogen bonding ki wajah se hai. (kitab ki chhapi tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing)
